messages:
Rae Chen: quick sync request 1: we need to align marketplace onboarding windows for H100/H200/B200, MI300, Gaudi. main blockers: image manifest cert, perf delta under 12%, and embargo timing. whos available for a 30m call tomorrow?
Tom Becker: available. propose a 2-phase plan: (1) staging claim & smoke, (2) cross-cloud canary + press handoff. keep press slots 48h apart.
Sonia (AMD): MI300 image ready for internal push on 2026-05-15. we'll include perf delta notes. can confirm manifest by 5/12.
Ann (NVIDIA): H200 images staging-ready 2026-05-13, NVTX hooks included. B200 backward-compat smoke passed.
Elsa (SI): SI asks: golden prompts and eval harness by 5/10, plus container runner image. otherwise integration blocks.
MarketplaceBot: staging slot availability: rwd-amd-mi300 (2026-05-15..2026-05-21), rwd-nvidia-h200 (2026-05-13..2026-05-19). claim at https://marketplace.example/claim
Rae Chen: action items: vendors confirm manifests by 5/12, SI deliver harness by 5/10, marketplace claims by 5/11. will schedule 30m kick for tomorrow 09:30 PT. react with :white_check_mark: when you own an item.
Tom Becker: Ill own staging claims and slot coordination. :white_check_mark:
Sonia (AMD): will confirm manifest by 5/12. :white_check_mark:
Ann (NVIDIA): will confirm image push and contact list. :white_check_mark:
Elsa (SI): will deliver harness and prompts by 5/10. :white_check_mark:
Rae Chen: note fallback plan: if MI300 microcode slips, route to H200 compatible variant and mark as "compat-degraded" in release notes. also prepare comms templates for partners + press.
Tom Becker: added rollback template to runbook.
Rae Chen: thanks everyone, posting calendar invite now.
